svg.aria-label: Production reference architecture for a course-built agent
svg.text: Production reference architecture for a course-built agent
Stateless replicas, durable state, a gateway, a permission gate, and traces everywhere
OpenTelemetry or LangSmith traces, cost and latency dashboards, CI eval gate, online sampling
State lives in Postgres and the search index, never in a replica's memory.
Dashed lines: state and telemetry. Solid lines: request path.
